additions.name: Colovore RNO01 — first data center

status.summary: Colovore's release of 9 September 2026 says it has officially opened the first liquid-cooled AI data center on its RNO01 campus in Sparks, Nevada (Reno metro), that this data center is fully leased by customers and that it provides 6 MW of liquid-cooled infrastructure. This supports operation of the first data center on the release date. It does not establish customer load, utilisation or the opening of the campus's second data center, which the same release says is under construction with projected completion in February 2027.

locator.precision: Centroid of the Storey County parcel at situs 100 Italy Dr (listed APN 509110, 7.73 geodesic acres, about 226 by 249 m) in the Nevada statewide parcel layer compiled to 31 December 2018 (county source date 9 July 2018). It locates the RNO01 property named by Colovore Reno 1 LLC's facility address, not either data-center building, a surveyed boundary or the works extent; the parcel may have been re-platted since 2018.
locator.identity_review: Storey County's notice for the Colovore Data Center ribbon cutting on 9 September 2026 (the release date) gives the venue as Colovore Data Center, 100 Italy Dr., McCarran, NV 89437. Colovore Reno 1 LLC's GOED incentive application gives its proposed facility address as 100 Italy Drive, McCarran, Storey County, and describes the project as the company's first Nevada data-centre presence; the packet's company timeline names RNO01 as the first Reno site (16 MW), and Colovore's Reno market page lists RNO01 in Sparks, NV with 16 MW in two halls. McCarran and Sparks are both used as mailing places for the Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center. The statewide parcel layer has exactly one Storey County parcel with situs 100 ITALY DR. RNO02 (Reno) is a separate site and is not located here. No geocoder, map viewport or industrial-park centroid is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The statewide layer publishes no positional accuracy and the parcel is a 2018 snapshot; the centroid represents a property of about 226 by 249 m whose buildings are not separately located.

additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 22 October 2026 against every row of sites.csv (542), projects.csv (575) and evidence.csv (2,880), the 231 source records and the identity mapping of verified_construction_core/2026-10-22-research-thirtyfourth, all pending queue fragments and all sources/*-holds.json, for Colovore, RNO01, Italy Dr/Drive, McCarran, Tahoe Reno/Tahoe-Reno Industrial, Storey County and Sparks. The only Colovore records are Colovore Hutto (Williamson County, Texas) and the held Colovore Alliance (Fort Worth); no Reno-area Colovore record, alias or address exists. No Atlas site, project, source record or pending fragment lies within 2 km; the nearest site is Microsoft Silver Springs (24.1 km). No other Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center campus is in the Atlas. Re-screened in verification on 22 October 2026 against verified_construction_core/2026-10-22-research-thirtysixth (549 sites, 582 projects, 2,922 evidence rows, its source records and identity mapping), all other queue fragments and all sources/*-holds.json: the Colovore records there are Colovore Hutto and the now-published Colovore Alliance (Fort Worth), both in Texas; no RNO01, Italy Dr, McCarran or Storey County record exists and nothing lies within 2 km (nearest Microsoft Silver Springs, 24.1 km).
additions.successor_review: The release is the latest Reno item in Colovore's news sitemap (captured 22 October 2026); the Reno market page captured the same day lists RNO01 as sold out and reports no pause or closure. No later status statement was found. The second RNO01 data center, under construction per the same release, is held for a later update because a second project cannot be added to a site created in the same update.

additions.name: Aligned PHX-05 Data Center — core and shell

status.summary: The City of Phoenix permit register records Aligned's PHX-05 core-and-shell building permits at 2500 W Union Hills Dr (23003918 'Aligned Energy PHX-05 Core and Shell' and 23020602 'PHX05-1 core and shell, building 5 floors 1, 2 and roof'), with the PHX-05 common-areas and second-floor TI permits, as DONE with a permit complete date of 26 August 2026. This supports completion of the PHX-05 core-and-shell, common-area and second-floor TI works on that date. The first-floor data-hall permit (23009280) remains open, so the data-hall fit-out, operation, IT load and tenancy are not established.

locator.precision: Centroid of Maricopa County Assessor parcel 209-15-008A (2500 W Union Hills Dr; 55.81 geodesic acres, about 483 by 591 m), owned by Aligned Data Centers Phoenix PropCo LLC. It locates the 55-acre Union Hills campus that also holds PHX-01/02/03, not the PHX-05 building, a surveyed boundary or the works extent.
locator.identity_review: Aligned's Phoenix page gives 2500 W Union Hills Drive, Phoenix 85027 and a 55-acre campus for both PHX-01/02/03 and PHX-05. The city's PHX-05 core-and-shell permits are recorded at the same address, and permit 23020602's point lies about 1.5 m from this centroid. The assessor has one parcel at that situs, 209-15-008A, owned by Aligned Data Centers Phoenix PropCo LLC, whose 55.81 acres match the stated campus size. Aligned's separate Behrend Drive parcels (about 1.6 to 1.8 km west-north-west), its Chandler PHX-04/PHX-06 and its Waddell PHX-07 properties are not used. No geocoder, map viewport or city centroid is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The assessor publishes no positional accuracy for parcel polygons; the centroid represents a 55.8-acre campus of about 483 by 591 m, and the PHX-05 building position within it is not established.
